subject.title: openclaw doctor should detect stale gateway lock files

question: Should maintainers adopt or rebase the open conflicting fork PR at https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/946, or retire it and allow a fresh target-repo fix for gateway-lock doctor coverage?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but an open fork PR still carries the old conflicting implementation and closing claim, so automation should pause until branch ownership is decided.

options.title: Replace the stale fork branch
options.body: Close or retire the conflicting fork PR and allow a fresh narrow OpenClaw PR to implement gateway-lock doctor coverage against current main.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork work
options.body: A maintainer can manually port the useful fork changes onto current main, keep contributor credit, and close the fork after a replacement lands.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Leave this issue paired with the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase it and add current real-behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Replace the stale fork branch
recommendation.body: Close or retire the conflicting fork PR and allow a fresh narrow OpenClaw PR to implement gateway-lock doctor coverage against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on the doctor health-check contract and contribution registry where this check should likely be wired.
